youtube.title: Roth IRA or 401(k)? One Question Decides It #Shorts
youtube.description:
$1,000 to invest: Roth IRA or 401(k)? For most people one question decides it: does your employer match your 401(k)? Here's the order that works for most beginners in 2026.

• 2026 limits: 401(k) $24,500; IRA $7,500 (IRS, Nov 2025 announcement for tax year 2026)
• A 100% match on your contributions doubles that money instantly. Match formulas vary, so check your plan.
• Roth: you pay tax now; qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax-free. Roth IRA eligibility phases out at higher incomes.

Full guide on the channel: "Roth IRA vs 401(k): Which Should You Fund First?".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
